messages.text: Morning. Surveillance queue has 11 new alerts overnight, mostly wire velocity rules. Two are tied to c_0092 operating account {{ACCOUNT_NUMBER:a_00196}}. Anyone already looking at those?
Not yet. I did the refresh on c_0092 earlier this year, risk rating is low and they've been a client since 2021. Probably seasonal payables but I'll pull the KYC file so you have context.
Thanks. The counterparty on the bigger one is Mcfarland LLC, CY-based. That's what bumped the geography rule, not the amount.

FYI for anyone tuning dispositions: the rule threshold change for wire velocity went live Wednesday. Expect more volume on commercial accounts until we recalibrate. I'm pulling a 30-day false positive rate now.
That explains the spike. Can you split the FP rate by segment? Commercial vs wealth would help me justify closing the low-risk ones faster.
Yep, will post in this thread by early afternoon. Also adding the counterparty country as a column in the alert export so you don't have to open each case.

Pulled the file. Beneficial ownership docs are current, and the Mcfarland payments match the invoicing pattern on record. Has a prior history with them going back a couple years. I'd lean toward closing with a note. Do you want the recipient details added to the case?
Yes please, add the beneficiary bank info as {{CP_IBAN:cp_020}} and {{CP_SWIFT:cp_020}} in the case notes so it's traceable. I'll document the rationale and close both c_0092 alerts.

Different one: wire_in of $234,191.01 on 8/19 into {{ACCOUNT_NUMBER:a_00273}} for {{CLIENT_NAME:c_0129}}. Fraud score was 0.64, surveillance is re-flagging it as a large inbound for a wealth account. Anyone have context?
0.64 is middling. Does the source of funds on file support a six-figure inbound from Rivas-Bryant? If wealth onboarding noted a property sale or similar, that could cover it.
Checking. Nothing explicit in the profile, so I'll ask the advisor for supporting docs before I decide. Holding the alert open until then.

FP numbers: commercial segment is running about 78% false positive since the change, wealth about 52%. I'll propose raising the geography weight cutoff for low-risk commercial clients. Will bring it to Marcus Monday.
That's helpful, thanks Jenna. I'll attach those figures to my disposition notes on the c_0092 cases.
Heads up, case notes for c_0092 are updated with the KYC summary. If the client reaches out about the holds, route them to the RM rather than sharing details, per usual.
